input.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'pnpm preview --host 127.0.0.1 > /tmp/buildstacks-ticket2-preview.log 2>&1 &
TASK_PREVIEW_PID=$!
echo "$TASK_PREVIEW_PID"
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  if curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:4321/ > /dev/null; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
curl --fail --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '"'%{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:4321/"
